query:
SELECT n.author_id,
               n.anonymous AS "anonymous!: bool",
               r.state     AS "retro_state!: String",
               s.project_id AS "project_id!: Uuid"
        FROM   retro_notes n
        JOIN   sprint_retros r ON r.id = n.retro_id
        JOIN   sprints s       ON s.id = r.sprint_id
        WHERE  n.id = $1 AND n.deleted_at IS NULL
